battle.name: 唐滅高昌之戰
battle.brief: 貞觀十四年八月，唐太宗以高昌王麴文泰阻絕西域商路、與西突厥相結，遣侯君集率兵萬餘西征；九月抵柳谷，文泰病卒，嗣君麴智盛據交河城固守，唐軍用雲梯、撞車、飛石、砲攻破之，智盛出降，國亡置西州。卡面的亞述長弓是複合弓祖型，經西域傳入，與唐軍胡弓同一血脈，但真正破城的仍是弩砲與撞車。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐與西域高昌國。高昌位於今新疆吐魯番盆地，漢文典籍先後稱其為「車師」「高昌」「西州」，國都交河城在火焰山北麓，境內另有柳中、柳谷、田地、赤城等城，國土東西約千里。城內居民以漢人、粟特胡人、車師後裔與吐谷渾人雜居，耕種菸麥、葡萄，亦畜牧馬羊，兼營商隊貿易。王族麴氏自稱漢家後裔，歷仕北涼、北魏與西域諸政權，至麴文泰時國勢方盛，控弦之士數萬，與西突厥往來密切，唐所置安西諸國的使者多取道高昌往來。西面唐廷以兵部尚書侯君集為西域道行軍大總管，統漢兵與鐵勒、鄯善等蕃兵，自長安出發取道河西走廊，糧秣由涼、甘、肅諸州轉運，目標直指交河城。這不是單一王國對單一王國，而是唐的邊疆體系對西域綠洲城邦聯盟的正面對撞。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Tang empire and the oasis kingdom of Gaochang in the Western Regions. Gaochang lay in what is now the Turpan basin of Xinjiang; Chinese texts called it in turn Shule, Gaochang and Xizhou. Its capital, Jiaohe, stood on the northern side of the Huoyan mountains, and the realm contained further towns such as Liuzhong, Liugu, Tiandi and Chicheng, stretching roughly a thousand li from east to west. The population mixed Han settlers, Sogdian merchants, descendants of the Chesi and people of Tuyuhun; they farmed wheat, barley and grapes, raised horses and sheep, and ran caravan trade. The ruling clan, the Qu, claimed descent from Han royalty, had served the Northern Liang, the Northern Wei and a succession of Western Regions polities, and under King Qu Wentai the kingdom was at its height, with tens of thousands of men able to draw a bow and close ties to the Western Turks; the envoys of the Anxi states that Tang maintained usually passed through Gaochang. On the Tang side, the Ministry of War minister Hou Junji was appointed overall commander of the expedition to the Western Regions, leading Han troops together with contingents of Tiele and Shanshan peoples out of Chang'an along the Hexi Corridor, while grain was shifted westward from Liang, Ganzhou and Suzhou. This was not one kingdom matched against another, but the imperial frontier system of Tang pressed against a coalition of oasis city-states of the Western Regions.
people: 關鍵人物一方在唐廷。太宗李世民詔令出兵，定下「先取高昌、通西域」的大計；兵部尚書侯君集奉命為西域道行軍大總管，統軍西行，抵柳谷後主持築土山、造攻城器械，攻城最力。左驍衛大將軍薛萬均、內蕃都督契苾何力等分率騎兵為左右翼，高昌王族麴勣隨軍至柳谷，招撫城中，曉以利害，勸其早降。高昌方面，王麴文泰聞唐兵至而嚇病而死，遺命嗣子守城；麴智盛在諸子勸說下開城出降，唐廷念其歸附之誠，授以官爵而安置京師。詔書到日，高昌群臣議久不決，太宗復遣使持書往諭，反覆申說「救亡取存」之義，主上以保全城邑與生靈為念。麴氏王族的開城，使唐軍不必以屠城收場，換來交河城完整與安西都護府駐紮的基地；反之，若沒有麴勣的入城招撫與麴智盛的出降，這場戰事仍要再耗去數倍時間與兵力。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the Tang side belonged to the court. Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin, issued the rescript that launched the campaign and fixed its grand design: take Gaochang first, and the Western Regions open. Hou Junji, minister of war, was named overall commander of the expedition to the Western Regions, led the army west, and after reaching Liugu took charge of raising earthen works and building siege machines, pressing the assault harder than anyone. Left Division general Xue Wanjun and the indigenous commander Qiebin Heli led cavalry on the wings, and the Gaochang prince Qu Mo followed the army to Liugu, parleying with the defenders and explaining the consequences of resistance to urge an early surrender. On the Gaochang side, King Qu Wentai, on learning that Tang troops had arrived, was frightened into illness and died, leaving his heir to hold the city. Qu Zhisheng was persuaded by his brothers to open the gates and surrender, and the Tang court, mindful of the sincerity of the surrender, granted him office and title and settled him at the capital. When the rescript arrived, the Gaochang ministers debated for a long time, and Taizong sent envoys again and again to explain the duty of saving the realm and preserving life. The opening of the gates by the Qu clan spared Tang a massacre and bought an intact Jiaohe city as the base for the Protectorate General to the Pacify the West; without the parley of Qu Mo and the surrender of Qu Zhisheng, the affair would have cost several times the time and the men.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓是西元前七世紀亞述帝國的複合弓，弓臂以木、角、筋三層黏合，單兵弓手不倚牆也能發出有力的一箭，是亞述人征服兩河流域時的標準配備，弓兵自車上射擊、車兵靠弓兵開路。它並未出現在貞觀十四年的交河城下，但它代表的那條技術血脈從未斷絕：亞述弓的形制經波斯高原與中亞塞種一路東傳，落到唐的兵仗庫就叫「胡弓」「角弓」，是唐軍步騎兩用的主武器，也是西域騎手的看家本事。此役真正消耗最大的，是唐軍的蹶張弩，以腳踏木架張弦，裝填省力、一次可連發數十箭，用來壓制城頭；西域守軍則以弓、投石與楯車拒守。破城一段用的雲梯、撞車、飛石與砲（拋石機）配合火箭焚燒城樓門扇。城防本身夯土築牆，外加木柵與深壕，據《新唐書》所記交河城「周二千五百步，高一丈五尺」，在當時算堅固的中等城防，也因此必須靠器械而非強攻才能拿下。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card face is the composite bow of the seventh-century BC Assyrian empire, its laminated grip of wood, horn and sinew, capable of loosing a heavy arrow without a wall to draw against. It was standard kit for the Assyrians as they conquered the two river valleys: archers shot from the chariot, and the chariotry advanced behind the archers. It never appeared beneath the walls of Jiaohe in 640, but the technical lineage it represents was never broken. The Assyrian form passed across the Iranian plateau and through the Saka of Central Asia, and by Tang times the same weapon sat in the arsenal under the names hu bow and horn bow: the principal missile weapon of Tang infantry and cavalry alike, and the livelihood of the Western Regions horsemen. The item consumed most heavily in this campaign was instead the Tang traction crossbow, cocked by a foot-operated wooden frame so that a soldier could loose a volley of dozens of arrows with little effort, and it was the crossbow that suppressed the parapets. The Gaochang garrison answered with bows, stone-throwers and movable shields. To breach the wall Tang used scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers and the traction catapult, with fire-arrows against the gate towers. The city itself was rammed earth ringed by a wooden palisade and a deep ditch; the New Book of Tang records Jiaohe as twenty-five hundred paces around and fifteen feet high, a moderately strong defence that had to be beaten down by machines rather than by storming alone.
tactics: 唐軍自長安出發，經武威、涼州、瓜州、敦煌，沿河西走廊的綠洲驛網逐段西行，抵達交河城東北的柳谷一帶時，六千餘里的唐里路程已走完大半。九月大軍進至田地城下，前哨與城頭接戰，唐軍隨即在城外選擇高處築土山，把弓弩手抬高到俯射城頭的位置，再以巢車、撞車、飛石與砲輪番壓制：砲石飛擲砸毀城樓與女牆，撞車反覆撞擊城門與城根，雲梯接近城垣時步卒攀梯而上。攻城晝夜不息，壕塹與填土同步向前推進，把城下的射界一寸寸吃掉。守軍以弓、投石、楯車自城頭反擊，屢次打退登城者，直到最後仍有數千守軍在城頭死守。最終在機械投射與遠程火力同時壓住城頭的形勢下，城門一段被突破，麴智盛出降。唐軍入城後封存府庫、登記戶籍、撫安百姓，隨即在西州置官設兵、屯田給軍。
tacticsEn: The Tang army left Chang'an and moved west through Wuwei, Liangzhou, Guazhou and Dunhuang, using the chain of oasis relay stations along the Hexi Corridor; by the time it reached Liugu north-east of Jiaohe most of the six thousand-odd li of the route lay behind it. In the ninth month the main force came up to Tiandi and the outposts engaged the parapets. The army then chose high ground outside the walls and raised earthen terraces, lifting crossbowmen and archers high enough to shoot down into the city, and pressed the assault in rotation with siege towers, battering rams, stone-throwers and the traction catapult. Catapult stones smashed the gate towers and the parapet, the rams struck the gate and the wall base again and again, and troops climbed the scaling ladders once they reached the wall. The siege did not stop day or night; the ditch and the causeway advanced together, eating away the defenders' field of fire inch by inch. The garrison replied with bows, stones and movable shields from the wall, throwing back each attempt to scale, and several thousand men held the parapet until the end. Only when machinery and missile fire together blotted out the wall did one section of the gate give way and Qu Zhisheng come out to surrender. Tang then sealed the treasuries, registered the households, pacified the population, and at once set up officials and troops in Xizhou, with soldiers farming to feed the army.
data: 兵力方面，通行記載稱唐軍出師萬餘人，另雜以西域蕃兵，攻城器械的數量與種類不見完整統計。距離方面，長安至交河約六千餘里，一唐里約合今五百三十一公尺，全程折合今約三千三百公里，故不能靠急行軍解決，只能沿綠洲驛站逐段推進。城池規模據《新唐書》所記交河城「周二千五百步，高一丈五尺」，以當時一步約合一點六公尺估算，周長約四公里，牆高約二公尺半。時間上，自八月中旬出師到九月抵達柳谷，行程約一個月，攻城自入秋延續至九月，前後約二十餘日，諸書略有出入。糧秣是此役最大變數：唐廷自涼州、甘州、肅州轉運，沿途設驛，運糧的隊伍往往長於作戰部隊，一旦河西補給線受阻或遇水，遠征即無以為繼。這也是唐太宗事後詔書屢次提到「不圖遠以疲人」的緣由。兵員傷亡的具體數目，各書記載互有出入且多有誇大，本文不取其詳，只據可核的行程與器械記載推想其規模。
dataEn: On strength, the received accounts give the Tang army as a little over ten thousand men, augmented by local Western Regions contingents; no complete tally of siege machines by type survives. On distance, Chang'an to Jiaohe is put at some six thousand li, a Tang li being about 531 modern metres, so the whole route comes to roughly three thousand three hundred kilometres, which no forced march could cover: the army had to advance stage by stage along the oasis stations. On the size of the city, the New Book of Tang gives Jiaohe as twenty-five hundred paces around and fifteen feet high; at about 1.6 metres to a pace of the period that is a perimeter near four kilometres and walls about two and a half metres high. On timing, the march from mid-eighth month to Liugu in the ninth month took about a month, and the siege of the city ran from early autumn into the ninth month, something over twenty days by the most usual reckoning, with the sources differing slightly. Supply was the real constraint of the campaign: grain was shifted from Liangzhou, Ganzhou and Suzhou with relay stations along the route, and the provisioning columns were often longer than the fighting force, so a single interruption on the Hexi road, or a flood, could end a distant expedition. This is why Taizong afterwards spoke repeatedly of not wearing the people out for distant goals.
cause: 高昌之所以必須被討伐，理由疊了三層。第一層是商路：高昌扼守吐魯番盆地的門戶，唐通往西域的使者與商隊多經其境，麴文泰卻對往來商旅徵收重稅、任意扣留，斷絕西域諸國與唐的交通，使安西各國的朝貢使節屢屢被截。第二層是主權：高昌既與西突厥結為婚姻、往來密切，又不肯服從唐的號令，麴文泰還曾出兵襄助西突厥攻擊唐在漠北與西域的據點，把西域諸國推向與唐對立。第三層是唐的戰略選擇：自貞觀年間平定東突厥、渾、吐谷渾之後，太宗認為西域的門戶若不取在唐手裡，北方的突厥勢力就會自北面壓下來，於是先取高昌、斷其臂膀，再圖西北。至於直接導火線，則是麴文泰在唐使到來時態度倨傲、朝貢不修，終於讓太宗下定兵出玉門的決心。詔書措辭仍留有餘地，只責其「絕商路、亂西域」，未用斷絕邦交之辭，可見唐廷初時仍以羈縻安撫為先，兵出之後才一路走向兼併。
causeEn: Three layers of reason made the campaign against Gaochang necessary. The first was commerce. Gaochang commanded the gateway of the Turpan basin, and the envoys and caravans of Tang heading west passed through its territory; Qu Wentai instead levied heavy dues on them, detained them at will and cut the communications between the Western Regions states and Tang, so that tribute envoys from Anxi were intercepted again and again. The second was sovereignty. Gaochang was linked to the Western Turks by marriage and intercourse, yet refused the authority of Tang; Qu Wentai even sent troops to help the Turks strike Tang outposts in the steppe and the Western Regions, pushing the oasis states toward alignment against Tang. The third was Tang strategic choice: after the pacification of the Eastern Turks, of the Xianbei and of the Tuyuhun during the Zhenguan era, Taizong held that unless the western gateway were seized first, pressure from the Turkic north would descend on it. Hence take Gaochang, cut the arm of the Western Turks, and only then turn to the northwest. The immediate occasion was the arrogance of Qu Wentai towards Tang envoys and his failure to maintain the tribute, which finally persuaded the emperor to put an army beyond Yumen.
impact: 高昌亡國是唐經略西域的關鍵一步。唐在交河城置西州，設安西都護府，府治後來西徙龜茲，唐在西域的行政與軍事存在由鬆散的羈縻轉為常設機構，安西四鎮（龜茲、于闐、疏勒、焉耆）也隨之成形。唐的勢力自此越過玉門，與西突厥在塔里木盆地北緣直接對峙，此後二十餘年間，鐵勒、薛延陀與西突厥的戰事多由安西都護府策應。絲路的通暢同樣改變了中亞的權力平衡：以往西域小國在高昌與突厥之間左右逢源，如今只能倒向唐的一邊，粟特商隊再不必繞道高昌受其盤剝。玄奘於貞觀二十年（645）自印度歸國，取道高昌故地與西州北返，正是高昌易主之後新通道暢行的實例。高昌的漢人居民在戰後編入西州版籍，改由唐廷直接治理，行政成本下降而秩序漸定，絲路沿線城市的格局也在此後數十年重新洗牌。
impactEn: The fall of Gaochang was the decisive step in Tang's western policy. Tang set up Xizhou at Jiaohe and established the Protectorate General to the Pacify the West there, the seat later moved west to Kucha, and its presence in the Western Regions changed from loose tribal arrangements into a standing institution; the four garrisons of Anxi, Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar and Yanqi took shape along with it. Tang power now reached past Yumen and stood face to face with the Western Turks on the northern rim of the Tarim basin, and for the next twenty years and more the wars against the Tiele, the Xueyantuo and the Turks were in large part directed from the Protectorate. The opening of the silk road also shifted the balance of power in Central Asia. Oasis states that had played the Gaochang and the Turks against one another could now only lean towards Tang, and Sogdian caravans no longer had to detour through Gaochang and pay its tolls. When Xuanzang returned from India in 645, he came back through the old Gaochang lands and Xizhou: a working example of the new route opened by the change of ruler. Han inhabitants of Gaochang were entered in the registers of Xizhou and came directly under Tang administration; the cost of governing fell, order improved, and the pattern of cities along the road was reshuffled over the following decades.
result: 貞觀十四年九月，高昌國滅。唐軍入交河城，麴智盛與高昌官屬奉表歸降，國土併入唐的版籍；唐於其地置西州，以交河城為治所，安西都護府駐紮，遣官管領戶籍、徵收賦稅、屯田以給軍糧。麴氏王族被遷往京師安置，高昌作為獨立政權在中原正史中從此不再出現，餘眾在之後數十年陸續被編入唐的郡縣與軍鎮。對唐而言，此役用兵數月即平一國，開地數千里，卻也暴露了遠征西域的真實代價：運糧千里、舟車勞師、水土不服，遠征的成敗最後往往不在戰場而在後勤。此役同時把唐的注意力從北方草原引向西域，隨之而來的是與薛延陀的正面交鋒，再是對西突厥的長期競逐；西亞與東亞之間的戰略天平，就此在唐的一側傾斜。高昌既平，唐在安西的駐軍與屯田有了可以長久維持的立足點，後續對西域的經營才有可能接續下去，而不必每年重開一場跨越六千里的遠征。
resultEn: In the ninth month of the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, the state of Gaochang ceased to exist. The Tang army entered Jiaohe, Qu Zhisheng and the officers of Gaochang presented a surrender tablet, and the land was folded into Tang's registers. Xizhou was established with Jiaohe as its seat, the Protectorate General to the Pacify the West was garrisoned there, and officials were sent to manage the households, collect taxes and farm to provision the troops. The Qu clan was moved to the capital; Gaochang disappears from the Central Plains annals as an independent state, and its remaining population was gradually enrolled in Tang commanderies and garrisons over the following decades. For Tang the campaign destroyed a kingdom in a matter of months and opened thousands of li of territory, yet it also exposed the true price of campaigning so far west: grain dragged over a thousand li, vehicles and boats exhausted, soldiers sick with the climate. The outcome of such distant expeditions is decided not on the battlefield but in supply. The war also turned Tang's attention from the northern steppe toward the Western Regions, and what followed was open war with the Xueyantuo and then a long rivalry with the Western Turks; the strategic balance between West and East tilted, on this occasion, to Tang's side.
